bio: While Beastbloods sleep soundly in their beds, a lone wolf patrols the streets. Armed with a Demon blade and a thirst for justice, Fenrich protects the terraces of Remnant from all manner of villainy. He does not seek adulation or fame, simply atonement. For along with his cursed sword, Fenrich bears a lifetime of sin. One that his heroics seek to atone for.
